title: Missed Bolus Window by Meal Type
dataSources: Pump telemetry (`health:glucose`), lab results (`health:lab`), therapy sessions (`health:pt`), symptom diaries (`health:symptom`), care tasks (`health:ops`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management telemetry — insulin-pump events, A1c lab imports, physical-therapy rep logs, and symptom diaries — streamed to Splunk HEC via device exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=health:glucose meal_type=* bolus_on_time=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(bolus_on_time="no",1,0))) as matched by meal_type
| eval a_missed_bolus_window_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_missed_bolus_window_pct
description: Measures the percentage of meal bolus events that end with a missed bolus window by meal type.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which meal type are helping or hurting meal bolus events.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a missed bolus window` on `health:glucose` events and summarize the hit rate by `meal_type`.
visualization: Table of meal type with percentage of meal bolus events ending with a missed bolus window.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how often a missed bolus window happens for each meal type so you can see where meal bolus events go smoothly or get stuck.
